summary: Preserve fail-closed ambiguous-write retry handling, explicit rate-limit recovery and truthful rollback progress after upstream maintenance updates.
reason: A caller idempotency key alone does not prove server-side write deduplication; transactional rollback must not report uncommitted rows as stored.
validated_outcome: Regression uses a synthetic TLS server to distinguish keyed502 failure (one call) from explicit429 rejection (bounded retry); existing full-suite store and custom duplicate/full-sync checks remain required.
